description: List outbound drafts. Useful for checking what's queued for the Mac agent, what is held by the new-outreach limit, what was recently sent, or what failed. By default returns drafts in any state; filter with status (preferred), or sent / send_error.

send_error.description: Filter: true = drafts that failed to send (held drafts are not failures and are excluded).

sent.description: Filter: true = delivered/cancelled, false = pending dispatch.

status.description: Filter on lifecycle status. "held" = parked by the new-outreach limit (resumes on its own); "blocked" = subscription_required / recipient_opted_out.

name: list_drafts
